edges.rationale: Node.js is a key technology used in backend development
TypeScript is used in conjunction with Node.js
NestJS is a framework built on top of Node.js
Redis is used as a database with Node.js
RabbitMQ is used as a message broker with Node.js
Azure is used as a cloud platform with Node.js
Jest is a testing framework used with Node.js
ts-mockito is a mocking library used with Jest
OpenAPI is used for API documentation with Node.js
Git is used for version control with Node.js
Excellent communication is a key soft skill for a backend developer
Willingness to learn new technologies is a key soft skill for a backend developer
Strong problem-solving skills are a key soft skill for a backend developer
Flexibility is a key soft skill for a backend developer
